title: CPSC, Crystal Mountain Water Cooler Corp. Announce Recall of Water Coolers
summary: The hot & cold water dispenser's heater band can short circuit, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, DeWALT Industrial Tool Co. Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
summary: The spindle on the saw may slip, causing the blade to contact the lower guard, posing a hazard to the consumer, from an exposed blade. Units: About 55,000.

title: Cadet Manufacturing Co. Recall of In-Wall Electric Heaters
summary: When an RM or ZM model heatbox (replacing a ZA or RA model heatbox) is inserted into a ZAC wall can and wired through a fitting in the top-left wall can knock-out (see the picture), the RM or ZM model has the potential for continuous heater operation, regardless of thermostat settings or room temper

title: CPSC and Federated Merchandising Group Announce Recall of Girl's Capri Pant and Shirt Set
summary: The buttons in the center of the embroidered flowers on the shirt can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Discovery Toys Announce Recall of Children's Toy
summary: The plastic tubes can break from the wooden base, releasing beads, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 21,000.

title: CPSC, Intercon Merchandising Source Announce Recall of Mini Beach Chairs Given with "Time Out" Cosmetics at Sears
summary: The chairs can collapse, posing crush and amputation hazards to consumer's fingers and toes. Units: About 100,000.

title: CPSC, Wenzel Reminds Consumers about Recall of Propane Camping Lanterns
summary: An insufficient connection between the lantern and the propane cylinder can allow gas to escape and ignite unexpectedly, posing a potential fire and injury hazard to consumers. This hazard can occur during the lighting or normal use of the lantern. Units: About 290,000.

title: CPSC, SC Johnson Announce Recall of Glade® Extra Outlet Scented Oil Air Fresheners
summary: These Extra Outlet PlugIns® may have been misassembled during manufacture, which could pose a risk of fire. Units: About 2.5 million.

title: CPSC, Brunswick Corp. Announce Another Expanded Recall of Mongoose and Roadmaster Mountain Bicycles
summary: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury. Units: About 103,000.

title: CPSC, Estes Industries Announce Recall of Air Powered Rockets
summary: The rockets' foam tips can break off, exposing sharp edges that can cause face lacerations or eye injuries to consumers. The rocket systems also have weak pump handles that can break during use, posing a risk of hand lacerations to consumers. Units: About 140,000.

title: CPSC, Hallmark Announce Recall of Harry Potter Key Chains
summary: The key chains can leak petroleum distillates, which can pose an ingestion hazard to children. Units: About 7,000.

title: CPSC, Ames True Temper Announce Recall of Wheelbarrows
summary: The plastic wheel assemblies on these wheelbarrows, manufactured by a predecessor company, can break when being inflated with high-pressure air hoses. This can result in plastic pieces exploding from the rims of the wheels, possibly hitting nearby consumers and causing lacerations and other injuries

title: CPSC and Gas-Fired Products Inc. Announce Recall of Water Heaters
summary: Over time, the heat exchanger could become blocked, creating a potential ventilation and cracking problem, posing a fire hazard, if nearby combustibles ignite. Units: About 1,300 Seahorse® and 25 "Bradford & White" water heaters.

title: CPSC, Country Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall for Repair of Cordless Electric Lawnmowers
summary: A wiring problem on the lawnmower's circuit board may cause some of the safety functions to become inoperable. The mower may continue to operate, after the Operator Presence Control Bar is released. The blade also may continue to spin for an extended period of time, after the mower has been shut off

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall for In-Home Repair of Infant Swings
summary: It is possible to misassemble the seats of these swings, so that they appear secure, but are not. If the seat of the swing is not properly attached, the seat and baby can flip forward. Units: About 42,000.

title: CPSC, Sherwood SCUBA LLC Announce Recall of Maximus Regulators
summary: The second stage orifices on these regulators can be cracked, bent or broken. This can result in a loss of breathing air underwater. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC, InSTEP LLC Announce Recall of Trailer Bikes
summary: The bike's universal joint system can fail, causing a rider to lose control of the bike. This poses a risk of injury to either of the two riders. Units: About 4,300.

title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The rear seatstays, the tube behind the seat that connects the rear axle to the rear shock, can break, possibly causing the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 2,200.

title: CPSC, Vermont Precision Woodworks Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: The slats on the cribs can loosen and detach from the drop side rail, creating a large opening between the slats, where a child's head or neck could become entrapped, resulting in serious injury or death. Units: About 990.

title: CPSC, Coast Energy Management Announce Recall of Power Saving Devices
summary: The Power Planner is a device connected between motorized appliances and wall outlets that is intended to save electricity. These Power Planners have reversed polarity, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 45,000.

title: CPSC, Horizon Fitness Announce Recall of Treadmills
summary: A component of the electronic control panel can malfunction, causing the motor and walking belt to rapidly accelerate and the user can lose balance and fall. Units: About 5,900.
